parents.course: US in an Age of Empire

ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: The global backstory to the United States of today, focusing on imperial dimensions of U.S. history from 1877 to 1920. Topics include the imperial world system, global trade and investments, labor migrations, missionary endeavors, civilizing aspirations, consolidation of U.S. power over Native Americans, anticolonial opposition, and U.S. political assertion, military interventions, territorial acquisitions, and colonial governance in places such as Hawaii, Puerto Rico, the Philippines, Guam, the Virgin Islands, Haiti, and the Panama Canal Zone.
